title: Changelog Glance: compact strip pack for release blog and quickstart
text:
Changelog Glance: compact strip pack for release blog and quickstart

description:
Goal: Produce a compact, reusable image pack ("Glance Strip Pack") for release posts and quickstart pages that highlights 3–5 small feature callouts and a before/after UI snapshot in a single horizontal strip suited for blog headers, docs, and GitHub release notes.

Scope:
- Create 3 size variants: hero wide (1200x360), inline blog (900x240), and mobile thumbnail (420x140).
- Provide layered Figma file + export presets (PNG, WebP, transparent SVG for overlays).
- Include localized copy slots (EN, DE, FR) with safe text boxes.
- Deliver 6 theme variants: Default (light), Default (dark), Focused CTA, Reduced-motion, High-contrast, and B&W print.

Constraints & considerations:
- Must be readable at thumbnail scale—limit callout copy to 10–12 words each.
- Keep token usage low for in-product generated screenshots (avoid heavy gradients).
- Accessibility: 4.5:1 contrast for text over image, provide alt text template for each asset.
- Avoid reusing existing visual metaphors used in prior packs (no split-circles or halo glows).

acceptance_criteria:
Three export sizes produced with correct pixel dimensions and naming conventions
Layered Figma file shared with engineering and content; links in ticket
PNG and WebP exports for each theme variant and size uploaded to Drive
Localized slots verified for EN/DE/FR with copy from PM
Contrast checks passed and alt text templates created
Design review approved by PM and Accessibility team

deliverables:
Figma master file (strip + components)
Export batch: hero_wide.png, blog_inline.webp, mobile_thumb.png (each theme)
Alt text spreadsheet and copy placeholders
Hand-off notes and usage guidance (Confluence link)
Mini animation spec for progressive reveal (reduced-motion fallback included)

assets:
3 size templates
6 theme variations
3 copy slots per strip (title, short callout, micro-note)
before/after overlay template with 2-state mask

comments:
2025-02-19 | Aisha Raman: Kickoff done — collected initial PM notes from @Lucia Gomez. PM prioritized three core flows: API changelog, Console release highlights, Quickstart updates.
2025-02-22 | Jonah Park: First-pass layouts uploaded to Figma. Chose horizontal stripe grid with 12px baseline; added masked before/after area. Awaiting copy from PM for DE/FR slots.
2025-02-25 | Lucia Gomez (PM): Added localized copy + microcopy variants in Drive. Prefer 'See the change' micro CTA for focused CTA theme. Please keep font size >= 14px for mobile thumbnail.
2025-02-27 | Accessibility team (Samir Patel): Contrast check failed on Dark theme CTA; increased alpha on overlay to pass 4.5:1. Marked for re-export.
2025-03-01 | Jonah Park: Re-exports uploaded. PRD link and draft blog mock attached. Ready for design review tomorrow (2025-03-03).
2025-03-02 | Aisha Raman: Noted engineering request to provide non-raster SVG overlays for client-side tinting. Added alternate export set and documented naming conventions.
